package v1

import (
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// RegisterHybridIntentRoutes mounts only explicit learner-owned consent commands.
// Caller supplies the existing authenticated /api/v1 router contour.
func RegisterHybridIntentRoutes(r chi.Router, h *handlers.StudentHybridIntentHandler) {
	if h == nil {
		return
	}
	r.Group(func(learner chi.Router) {
		learner.Use(middleware.RequireRole("STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO"))
		learner.Post("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/learning-intents", h.CreateLearningIntent)
		learner.Get("/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/learning-intents/{intentID}", h.GetLearningIntent)
	})
}
